archetypes.name: Red-White Battle Cry
archetypes.plan: Build around Accorder Paladin: Build a wide attacking force, stack battle cry triggers, and preserve enough bodies for one overwhelming combat.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Infect
archetypes.plan: Build around Viridian Corrupter: Apply poison with efficient infect creatures and use removal or combat tricks to force the last counters through.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Proliferate
archetypes.plan: Build around Core Prowler: Seed poison or charge counters early, then proliferate repeatedly while removal slows opposing pressure.

archetypes.name: White-Blue Artifacts
archetypes.plan: Build around Vedalken Infuser: Build around cheap artifacts and evasive creatures, switching on artifact bonuses while interaction protects the clock.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Dinosaurs
archetypes.plan: Build around Fangren Marauder: Accelerate with mana Myr into large creatures, then turn sacrificed or destroyed artifacts into enough life to dominate combat.
